scope: Targeted multidisciplinary search pass, indexed abstracts and selected full-text sections, not systematic screening. Registry checked by normalized title, DOI, PMID and exact URL. Staged overlay deliberately preserves the 382-record authoritative release snapshot; review matches and full source metadata before promotion. Not independent studies count.

source_candidates.title: Preconception lifestyle interventions for women—a systematic review and meta-analysis of intervention characteristics and behaviour change techniques
source_candidates.finding: 24 trials/7795 women; most infertility populations; not all contributed to each outcome. Clinical pregnancy and live birth intervals include null.

source_candidates.title: Preconception Interventions in Women at High Risk of Developing Gestational Diabetes: A Systematic Review
source_candidates.finding: Six RCTs/nine reports; 909 participants, five underpowered for GDM, no significant GDM effect in any trial; four continued into pregnancy. No proof that prevention impossible.

source_candidates.title: Calcium supplementation for prevention of pre-eclampsia: a systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis of randomised trials
source_candidates.checked_locator: Indexed publisher abstract and Birmingham institutional record; publisher full page blocked
source_candidates.finding: Allotey et al. October 2026. Five IPD trials n=14763 for PE, three n=13413 for early PE. No clear reduction or observed effect modification; no independent cohort count relative to S092. WHO process is not automatically an updated recommendation.

source_candidates.title: Calcium supplementation for prevention of pre-eclampsia in high-risk women: study protocol for a randomised triple-blind placebo-controlled trial (CaPE)
source_candidates.finding: NIHR HTA funded; high-risk women eligible for aspirin; calcium vs placebo added to usual care. Not an efficacy result or recommendation.

source_candidates.title: Does probiotic ingestion reduce the risk of preeclampsia? A systematic review
source_candidates.finding: Search through February 2022; RR 1.12 (0.83–1.53), I² 0%, six comparisons inferred from df=5; exact n and overlap not extracted. Do not pool as independent with S094/S095.

source_candidates.title: Omega-3 supplementation in addition to prenatal vitamins during pregnancy is associated with lower rates of preterm birth and small for gestational age
source_candidates.finding: nuMoM2b parent cohort 9461 nulliparous participants; actual analysis denominator not extracted; observational association, not randomized dose or causal proof.

source_candidates.title: A prospective study of breast anthropomorphic measurements, volume and ptosis in 605 Asian patients with breast cancer or benign breast disease
source_candidates.finding: 605 breast-surgery patients; breastfeeding history associated with more severe ptosis in adjusted models; no prepregnancy measurements, no randomized feeding choice; differs from Rinker S044/S045; not a representative longitudinal pregnancy cohort.

source_candidates.title: Quantitative Changes in Breast Density and Mammographic Features Induced by Pregnancy and Lactation: A Longitudinal Study
source_candidates.finding: Three mammography timepoints: prepregnancy, lactation, postweaning. Density/compression are not external breast shape or ptosis; selection, therapy and weight confounding. Does not establish cosmetic prevention.

source_candidates.title: Vastus Lateralis Architecture Changes During Pregnancy – A Longitudinal Study
source_candidates.finding: 19 pregnant, 15 nonpregnant controls; 16±4 and 29±4 gestational weeks, 32±9 weeks postpartum. Knee extensor strength stable; thickness and pennation increased late then returned; hydration confounding. No training assignment; only two prepregnancy measures.

source_candidates.title: Safety and efficacy of supervised strength training adopted in pregnancy
source_candidates.finding: Small supervised strength-training cohort over 12 weeks; primary full text blocked at open. Not evidence of maximal load safety or preservation of whole-body muscle mass.

source_candidates.title: Effect of a Mobile App-Based Exercise Program on Diastasis Recti Abdominis, Muscle Strength, Anthropometric Measures, and Satisfaction Among Post-Cesarean Primiparous Mothers: A Randomized Controlled Trial
source_candidates.finding: 40 primiparous post-CS women, 20 each app vs traditional exercise. Above navel post medians .89 vs 1.10 cm (p<.001); below 1.19 vs 1.30 cm (p=.122). Baseline above both 1.32; below 1.58 vs 1.44. Manual test medians 8 vs 7 after both started at 4; near/perfect separation and retrospective registration NCT07001046 merit scrutiny. No equivalence to this app, self-directed clearance or long-term efficacy. Funding PNURSP2025R785.
source_candidates.funding: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University PNURSP2025R785

source_candidates.title: Effects of Pilates on inter-recti distance, thickness of rectus abdominis, waist circumference and abdominal muscle endurance in primiparous women
source_candidates.design: Controlled exercise study; allocation not independently confirmed
source_candidates.finding: 20 exercise/15 controls analyzed; four weeks, 50 min/day five days/week. Reported improved gap, circumference, endurance; exact between-arm difference and attrition not extracted. No assertion of randomization, superiority or prevention.

source_candidates.title: Pregnant women may exercise both abdominal and pelvic floor muscles during pregnancy without increasing the diastasis recti abdominis: a randomised trial
source_candidates.finding: 12-week prenatal intervention in women with DRA; immediate and 6-week postpartum IRD assessment. Obtain exact confidence intervals, measurement site, sample and harms before charting. No unrestricted clearance.

source_candidates.title: An open single-arm clinical study of microneedle radiofrequency technology for addressing abdominal skin laxity in postpartum women
source_candidates.checked_locator: Indexed abstract and publisher methods; full page blocked
source_candidates.finding: 17 women, mean 7.63±7.88 years after birth (range 1.75–37). Not early postpartum recovery; no comparator, no reliable causal or durability conclusion. FDA RF microneedling warning retains precedence.

source_candidates.title: Reduction of abdominal skin laxity in women postvaginal delivery using the synergistic emission of radiofrequency and targeted pressure energies
source_candidates.finding: Combined device after vaginal delivery; authors report improved signs, but exact n, between-arm effect and funding/harms not extracted. Not standalone RF, not microneedling, not pregnancy prevention.

source_candidates.title: Electrical stimulation and biofeedback combined with pelvic floor muscle training for pelvic floor dysfunction in postpartum women: a systematic review and meta-analysis
source_candidates.finding: Triple combination vs PFMT alone; reported SUI RR .36 (.26–.49), sexual-function MD 4.38 (3.41–5.34); exact outcome scales, n, bias, overlap and reporting not fully extracted; no universal strengthening/device schedule.

source_candidates.title: Effects from a single application of photobiomodulation on pain intensity from perineal trauma related to childbirth: A randomized controlled trial
source_candidates.finding: 60 postpartum participants with perineal trauma and NRS≥4. NRS at 30min 3.63±2.57 vs 2.53±2.15 p=.089; healing score no clear difference. Does not establish equivalence or repeated-session effects. Registry U1111-1279-3594.

source_candidates.title: Physical Rehabilitation for Postpartum Perineal Morbidity After Episiotomy and Childbirth-Related Perineal Trauma: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
source_candidates.finding: Two laser vs sham RCTs n119: pain SMD -.16 (-.52,.19), p=.37. Trial overlap with DR017 not confirmed; do not combine as independent. Not evidence about other light doses or indications.

source_candidates.title: Pregnancy, birth outcomes, and postpartum injury in elite to world-class runners: a mixed methods study
source_candidates.finding: Published 2026-09-18; elite runner sample, version subject to final edits; do not generalize to all postpartum people. Exact injury denominators, training exposure and ascertainment pending.

source_candidates.title: Mediterranean Diet, Semen Quality, and Medically Assisted Reproductive Outcomes in the Male Population: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
source_candidates.checked_locator: Full text abstract and quantitative analysis
source_candidates.finding: 11 articles/2558 individuals; eight observational studies n1835 pooled, two RCTs separately described. Semen parameters associated with adherence; only one prospective medically assisted reproduction outcome study, no association. Surrogates not live birth. PROSPERO CRD42024584003.

source_candidates.title: Effectiveness of Exercise Training on Male Factor Infertility: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis
source_candidates.finding: Seven RCTs/2641; includes three explicitly retracted reports DR023–025. Do not import pooled effects, ranks, or fertility claims until reanalysis removes invalid trials. No assertion NMA itself formally retracted.
source_candidates.correction_retraction_status: dependency hold; review not established formally retracted

source_candidates.title: Exercise intervention improves fertility outcomes in females and males: an umbrella review of meta-analyses
source_candidates.finding: Includes DR021 as seven trials/2641, assigns low risk/moderate quality; no retraction discussion located in targeted page find. Hold DR021-derived male estimates, not unrelated female results; independent overlap and retraction-aware reassessment needed.
source_candidates.correction_retraction_status: dependency hold; review not established formally retracted

source_candidates.title: Moderate aerobic exercise training for improving reproductive function in infertile patients: A randomized controlled trial
source_candidates.finding: Retraction notice PMID 38030527 (2024 issue; online 2023-11-28). Exclude from clinical evidence; provenance only. DR021 ref9.

source_candidates.title: High-intensity interval training modulates male factor infertility through anti-inflammatory and antioxidative mechanisms in infertile men: A randomized controlled trial
source_candidates.finding: Retraction notice PMID 37277302. Exclude from clinical evidence; provenance only. DR021 ref8.

source_candidates.title: Effects of Aerobic, Resistance, and Combined Exercise on Markers of Male Reproduction in Healthy Human Subjects: A Randomized Controlled Trial
source_candidates.checked_locator: PubMed retracted publication and publisher notice
source_candidates.finding: Retraction DOI 10.1519/JSC.0000000000004451 (July 2023). Exclude from clinical evidence; provenance only. DR021 ref11.

source_candidates.title: Sleeping for Two: a randomized controlled trial of cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia in pregnancy
source_candidates.finding: Pregnancy-adapted CBT-I improved insomnia symptoms with benefits maintained up to six months postpartum per authors. Not generic sleep hygiene or a substitute for mental-health care. Secondary depression report PMID39029668 likely same cohort; verify.

source_candidates.title: Folic Acid: Facts for Clinicians
source_candidates.finding: People planning pregnancy not already taking folic acid: begin at least one month before conception and continue during pregnancy; general prevention guidance, not individualized high-risk dosing.

source_candidates.title: Planning to Get Pregnant? Plan to See Your Ob-Gyn
source_candidates.finding: Prepregnancy visit at least three months ahead and up to one year ahead suggested; does not establish exact three-year intervention efficacy.

source_candidates.title: Factors influencing breast changes after pregnancy
source_candidates.finding: 559 responses from 5991 eligible births; selection/nonresponse major limitation; exact effect direction and adjusted estimates not extracted, candidate only.

source_candidates.title: Breastfeeding and perceived changes in the appearance of the breasts: a retrospective study
source_candidates.finding: 496 first-time mothers interviewed ~18 months after birth; no observed association with breastfeeding per authors. Self-perceived appearance, not objective change. Conflict with DR007 does not establish causal benefit or harm.

source_candidates.title: Graduated compression stockings effects on chronic venous disease signs and symptoms during pregnancy
source_candidates.finding: 60 women (30/30); vein diameter and symptoms reported; distinguish within-arm changes, edema and persistent cosmetic vein outcomes. Potential same cohort as PMID32659162, not separate until confirmed.

source_candidates.title: Compression stocking prevents increased venous retrograde flow time in the lower limbs of pregnant women
source_candidates.finding: 60 women (30/30), vein reflux measurements; possible shared cohort DR031. No prevention of long-term spider veins established.

source_candidates.title: Preconception nutritional supplementation and behavioral interventions and their association with maternal and neonatal health: A systematic review and meta-analysis
source_candidates.finding: 24 studies; RCTs and nonrandomized designs. No pooled estimate combining intervention classes; abstract supports outcome-specific assessment. Publisher total n and listed arm totals differ; do not infer pooled sample until reconciled.

topic_status.next: Gemini: obtain primary data and subgroup interaction, independent sponsorship definitions and reanalysis code.

topic_status.status: DR014/015 device studies; long time since birth and different modalities, no long-term prevention evidence.
topic_status.next: Gemini: durability ≥12mo, skin type and adverse event denominators, surgery vs spontaneous recovery.

topic_status.status: DR011–013 plus S028/S030; app-based and Pilates studies, prenatal abdominal trial; separate site and function.
topic_status.next: Gemini: exact randomized arm data and matched timepoints, registration discrepancies and overlap.

topic_status.status: DR014/015 pertain to skin, not abdominal wall; binder and hernia thresholds still open.
topic_status.next: Gemini: binder adverse events, functional outcomes, hernia/surgical recurrence after subsequent pregnancy.

topic_status.status: DR007–008, DR029–030 conflict/context. Surgical association differs from older subjective reports; objective mammography is not ptosis.
topic_status.next: Gemini: longitudinal external shape, support garments, adjustment and cohort representativeness.

topic_status.status: DR001/002/027/028/033 and fertility hold DR021–025; ordinary habits vs tested preconception clinical interventions.
topic_status.next: Gemini: preconception RCT duration, long-term cohort and resistance-specific outcomes, time-to-pregnancy not body target.

topic_status.status: DR009/010/013; acute and longitudinal muscle data distinct from training effectiveness. Existing CL05 and H033–036.
topic_status.next: Gemini: strength/hypertrophy, prenatal high-load trials, adverse events, trimester and diagnosis.

topic_status.status: DR011/019; athlete study not generalizable, injury denominator open.
topic_status.next: Gemini: prospective injuries, lactation/cesarean and energy availability.

topic_status.next: Gemini: high tone, dyspareunia, diagnostic groups, clinical importance and device harms.

topic_status.next: Gemini: assisted birth, perineal compresses, delayed pushing and patient-valued harms.

topic_status.next: Gemini: original PE adjudication, unpublished safety, calcium disputed trials, omega-3 baseline and arm data.

topic_status.next: Gemini: extract S212 design and pregnancy studies; separate treatment and prevention.

topic_status.next: Gemini: persistent shedding diagnosis, lactation infant reports, treatment and nails.

topic_status.next: Gemini: silicone/massage, healed wound, recurrence, long-term harms.

topic_status.next: Gemini: registry overlap, adherence and postpartum durability.

topic_status.next: Gemini: sham acupuncture, belt/manual therapy and function harms.

topic_status.next: Gemini: postpartum prevention vs treatment, longer outcomes, partner burden and body image.

integrity_hold.rule: Retraction chain documented: DR021 Results explicitly includes refs 8,9,11, which are DR024,DR023,DR025 respectively. DR022 Table 1/ref34 includes DR021. Do not promote affected estimates until outcome-specific reanalysis; no claim of formal retraction of either synthesis. Search other reviews and guidelines for the same trial IDs.

preconception_timing.status: planning framework only, not trial-proven optimal lead time
preconception_timing.action: General health maintenance, enjoyable sustainable activity and ordinary dental care; avoid cosmetic or supplement schedules claimed to prevent changes.
Consider individualized prepregnancy visit and medication, immunization, health and partner risk review.

preconception_timing.status: specific public-health timing for folic acid
preconception_timing.action: Use current CDC guidance and clinician review for high-risk situations; no individualized dosing.

limitations: No comprehensive publication status check, dual screening, full texts where blocked, original arm-data reconstruction, pooled recalculation or clinical review; funding/COI null is unknown. All 22 gaps stay open. Search results not a complete list. Numeric source candidates use provisional DR IDs, do not merge with final import until deliberate reconciliation.
